page_title: LEC 1-0 GEN | Lecce v Genoa 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
89' Here is a change. Ylber Ramadani is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce).
88' Jamil Siebert (Lecce) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Doveri no option but to blow his whistle.
85' Flag up against Konan Ndri (Lecce). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
83' Here's the change. Patrizio Masini leaves the pitch and Filippo Carbone (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
83' That will be all from Alessandro Marcandalli who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Gael Lafont (Genoa).
80' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Santiago Pierotti is replaced by Gaby Jean (Lecce).
80' Substitution. Nikola Stulic (Lecce) in, Walid Cheddira out.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
77' Jacopo Grossi (Genoa) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Genoa.
76' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

71' Ambitious effort from Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
69' Daniele De Rossi decides to make a substitution. Amorim will be replaced by Jacopo Grossi (Genoa).
68' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.
65' Today's match ends for Lameck Banda who will be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
64' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

63' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Genoa are awarded a corner kick.
62' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) is caught offside!
60' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Wedtoin Latif Ouedraogo (Genoa) replaces Stefano Sabelli.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aaron Martin departs the field of play to be replaced by Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa).
56' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
54' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.
49' The resulting corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is cleared by the defence.

49' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Omri Gandelman (Lecce) comes on the pitch for Oumar Ngom.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' A yellow card for a tackle by Ylber Ramadani (Lecce). Daniele Doveri doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
43' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
42' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle. Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) commits a foul after dangerous play.
39' A goal, which was scored by Morten Frendrup (Genoa), was disallowed due to offside.
36' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
34' The Genoa players are exchanging some short passes.
30' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) is adjudged offside.
29' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 41:59.
23' Lameck Banda (Lecce) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Doveri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
20' Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

20' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.

16' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
15' Lameck Banda (Lecce) will deliver the corner kick.

14' Nicola Leali pulls off a great save to deny Lameck Banda (Lecce), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. The referee points to the corner flag and Lecce will take a corner.
11' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
6' 1 - 0 Lameck Banda (Lecce) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball under the crossbar.
6' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Nicola Leali is alert and denies him.
4' It looks like Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Doveri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
2' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
1' Nils Zatterstrom (Genoa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniele Doveri signals.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Genoa will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri was nominated as the referee for this game.
